title: Bridge base-owned verifier layout tests
goal: Let the base manifest fixtures validate either side of the verifier ownership relocation without accepting duplicate authorities.
acceptanceCriteria: The manifest fixture resolves exactly one legacy or engine-owned verifier.
All existing positive and negative manifest cases run unchanged through the resolved verifier.
A missing or duplicate verifier layout fails before fixture execution.
D33 records the public CI wrapper and internal manifest verifier compatibility boundaries.
